who.title: One app, for both directions
who.lead: Whether you send money from the UK to Iran or receive it from Iran, the offices' rates sit side by side. And the offices post their rates themselves.

items.label: Send to Iran
items.title: Most toman
items.body: You pay pounds; toman arrives in Iran. Offices sit side by side in order of Highest payout, fee included.

items.alt: A traveller with a phone in an airport lounge
items.label: Receive from Iran
items.title: Least toman
items.body: You pay toman in Iran; you get pounds here. Switch the direction to see which office asks the least toman per pound.

items.title: Sundays, the week in summary
items.body: Most UK offices are closed on Sundays. The app doesn't go empty: it shows last week's summary, and the offices that are open come to the top.

items.title: Offline, still in the know

faq.title: Questions people often ask
faq.body: The same answers you'll find inside the app.

items.a: No. NetRate is not an exchange office and never moves any money. It only puts the rates the offices themselves post side by side; the deal is directly between you and the office.

Your money never reaches us, so its safety depends on the office you deal with. The “Verified” badge, user ratings and “Always up to date” on each office's page are there for exactly that; look at them before you deal.
Each office has its own rate and fee, and its cash, bank transfer and official invoice rates differ too. That's why, once you type an amount, the order is by the money you get after the fee.
The rate an office gives for a transfer with its official invoice, for when you need formal proof of payment. It usually differs a little from cash and bank transfer.

items.q: What does an expired rate mean?
items.a: A rate the office hasn't updated today. It stays for one day, faded and labelled, then goes; it's never counted in the order or the average.
In one of two equal ways: two active verified offices vouch for it, or it gives its company number and AML number and our team checks them. The badge can't be bought and has only one level.

items.q: Why are there so few rates on Sunday?
items.a: Most UK offices are closed on Sundays. That day you see last week's summary, and the offices that are open come to the top of the list.

items.q: Do I need an account to see rates?
items.a: No. Rates, the office list, the chart and search all work without an account. You only need one for rate alerts, saved offices and writing reviews.
